premises.text: The modern web forces users to jump across sites, tabs, and single-purpose apps to assemble everyday tasks like planning a night out
premises.evidence_span: we've traded the fluidity and connectedness of surfing for stacks of browser tabs and single-purpose mobile apps

premises.text: VIRB weaves third-party services into contextual cards, persistent activity streams, and shareable collections on web and mobile with deep links
premises.evidence_span: reinvent surfing the internet on web or mobile by weaving together services you use

premises.text: Semantic search and recommendations power contextual bridges across services
premises.evidence_span: To build these contextual bridges across services, we use data technologies like semantic search and recommendations

premises.text: Initial service graph focuses on places, movies, and media
premises.evidence_span: We're starting by connecting services around places, movies, and media

value.text: Fluid multi-service getting-things-done in one place across screens
value.evidence_span: Verb is an intelligent layer over the internet that helps you get things done in one place

causal_links.evidence_span: why do we need to settle on a fragmented web?
when we can weave together these services, we can explore opportunities around this interconnected graph
connecting services around places, movies, and media
